episode.subject_description: Door handle, the hand-operated fitting used to open and close a building door, called Türfalle in Swiss German. The target is the handle fitting itself, not the whole door, a lock mechanism, or the material from which the handle is made. It is a general type, with no particular material, design, brand, or individual handle specified.
